connections.observation: The painter simile at 377e (γραφεύς, εἰκάζῃ, ἐοικότα, ὅμοια in s005) defines bad ψεῦδος (s003) as making οὐσία unlike what it depicts; the step-by-step deduction at 379b (s015) then constructs the correct likeness of ὁ θεός by tying ἀγαθόν to non-βλάπτειν to non-αἴτιον κακοῦ. The painter's failed resemblance and the chain's forced resemblance stand at opposite ends of the section on the same axis of εἰκάζειν οὐσίαν.

The αἴτιον/ἀναίτιον pair (s001) is quantified at 379c by ὀλίγων/πολλῶν and ἐλάττω (s016), and the Homeric πίθοι and ταμίας (s017) are quoted immediately after as the rejected image of a Zeus who dispenses both. The two jars and the steward figure the very πάντων αἴτιον that ὀλίγων/πολλῶν has just partitioned away.

ἔργα καὶ πάθη (s009) recur bound to kinship (s013): Kronos's ἔργα καὶ πάθη ὑπὸ τοῦ ὑέος at 378a return at 380a as Νιόβης πάθη and θεοῦ ἔργα. The same word-pair carries first intra-divine kin-violence and later the human sufferer set against divine deed.

The ποιηταί/οἰκισταί contrast (s006) is joined at 379a to τύποι (s007), which by 380c returns as νόμων τε καὶ τύπων (s018); the proliferating verbal adjectives in -τέον (s008) fill the space between, so that οἰκισταί do not ποιεῖν μύθους but issue λεκτέον, ἐατέον, ποιητέον directives that culminate as νόμος.

σιγᾶσθαι and the restriction of ἀκούειν to the fewest through a costly μέγα καὶ ἄπορον θῦμα (s010, s011) at 378a are answered at 378d–e by δυσέκνιπτα and ἀμετάστατα (s014): what is heard young sets indelibly, so the ritual barrier at 378a and the psychological indelibility at 378d name the same problem of ἀκοή from opposite sides.

The war-cluster πολεμοῦσι, ἐπιβουλεύουσι, μάχονται, γιγαντομαχία, θεομαχία, ἔχθρα, ἀπεχθάνεσθαι (s012) is placed exactly at πρὸς συγγενεῖς τε καὶ οἰκείους (s013): the enmity terms and the kinship terms coincide, so that divine warfare is articulated only as kin-warfare.

The νόμος named at 380c (s018) is ratified by Adeimantus's σύμψηφος, which stands beside σύμφορα and σύμφωνα αὐτὰ αὑτοῖς (s019). The σύν- prefix of the criteria for permitted speech reappears in the σύν- prefix of the assent that closes the νόμος.

elements.context: ὡς Οὐρανός τε ἠργάσατο ἅ φησι δρᾶσαι αὐτόν
ὁ μὲν θεὸς δίκαιά τε καὶ ἀγαθὰ ἠργάζετο

new_signals.observation: ἐργάζομαι appears at 377e for Ouranos's rejected deeds and returns at 380b for what θεός is to be said to have worked, δίκαιά τε καὶ ἀγαθά.
κολάζω recurs: at 378b the young man punishing his father is forbidden, at 380b those punished are benefited and κόλασις is what the wicked needed.
